selection: Earliest chronological contiguous accepted/published run; first 60 attempts. Skips do not count; gaps break; recorded late attempts retained. No outcome or latency based selection.
finalization: Wait for all first 60 to have settlement states. Keep any other not-yet-due predictions visible. Independently audit every published prediction in the frozen evidence cutoff.
latency: Retain every delay; evaluate the first-60 window, whole qualifying run, and whole candidate with the existing nearest-rank p95<=20 seconds.
input_consistency: Both frozen auditors must use the same raw SQLite copy and evidence cutoff; their logical table digests must match.
